prompts.open:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE independent photorealistic packaging photograph, OPTION 3 OPEN, landscape 3840x2160 4K if available. Five input refs: 1=exact Falcon white closed folding-carton silhouette; 2=exact Falcon open carton construction; 3=exact burgundy Musdal paper sleeve artwork; 4=exact round burgundy lam seal; 5=exact burgundy thank-you card artwork. These refs are identity/material references, no collage.
Scene: pale natural limestone countertop, unobtrusive out-of-focus pale stone background. Strong low natural afternoon window light and soft-edged long shadows, neutral natural whites not orange/yellow, elegant cinematic Sony full-frame 85mm f/5.6 photography. Sharp paper and cardboard texture, tiny realistic wrinkles and edge imperfections, restrained film grading, slight background depth of field, believable real photograph.
Subject: ONE stock-white outside/natural kraft brown inside CORRUGATED square tuck-top mailer 20x20x10 proportions2:2:1. Hinged ATTACHED lid upright, rounded lateral locking tabs fully visible as in reference2. Thin folded carton walls, corrugated exposed edges, no rigid two-piece gift box, no removable lid, no magnets. External white cardboard blank. Inside, folded garment FULLY concealed inside fine translucent ivory butter-paper-like tissue, sparsely printed with small burgundy long-stem lam icons, much blank tissue. Diagonal folded flap closed with ONE round burgundy sticker carrying EXACT ivory long-stem curved-bowl lam from ref4. Tissue looks delicate and lightweight, not fabric or thick wrapping.
Near the open box, removed separate burgundy paper sleeve lies naturally as a credible folded paper loop, NOT a ribbon or bow. Its horizontal panel has the EXACT ivory long-stem lam from ref3. Its front vertical panel is clearly visible, with exact approved Arabic مُسدل wordmark, small spaced M U S D A L, exact lowercase musdal.com, and restrained copper flowing-wave pattern at bottom from ref3. Burgundy #5C1E32, ivory ink, sleeve medium width covering about one-third of box when fitted. Keep all logos exact in shape.
ONE small BURGUNDY thank-you card beside the box oriented face-up so text is legible: copy reference5 exactly, only approved small ivory wordmark with spaced MUSDAL and the text "شكرًا لاختيارك مُسدل". No other wording, no QR, no discount, no scratch patch. Natural three-quarter editorial camera angle high enough to see diagonal tissue fold/seal and brown interior. Keep all objects completely in frame with room around edges. No bag, cake, flowers, hands, extra cards, decorative props, labels, layout panels, watermarks. The carton construction and approved branding are paramount.
